result.question: Why were the descendants of Dan looking for territory?

readings.answer: Because they had not yet received an inheritance among the tribes of Israel.
readings.support: For up to that time they had not come into an inheritance among the tribes of Israel.

assessments.reason: The answer restates the explicit clause in 18:1: “For up to that time they had not come into an inheritance among the tribes of Israel,” which explains why they were looking for territory.

result.reason: The passage directly states they were seeking territory because they had not yet received an inheritance among Israel’s tribes.
